title: SG-5.5.2 Make BootScene tests type-check and pass with sceneSpec mock
summary: BootScene suites mock sceneSpec and tsc reports no errors in the four named places
description: Context: bootScene*.test.ts mock '../src/runtime/content', and tsc still reports constructor-arity, implicit-any and tuple errors in tests/bootSceneEffects, tests/bootSceneBuild, tests/bootSceneFallback and src/phaser/BootScene.ts. Desired behavior: mocks include sceneSpec and the four errors disappear. Expected result: the BootScene suites pass and tsc reports none of those errors. Why: the thin-wrapper refactor (SG-5.5) must stay verifiably typed.
acceptance_criteria: Given tsc --noEmit in game/frontend, When it runs, Then no error is reported at BootScene.ts line 42 or in bootSceneEffects, bootSceneBuild or bootSceneFallback tests
Given the bootScene*.test.ts suites, When run with vitest, Then every suite mocks sceneSpec in the content mock and passes
technical_constraints: No any casts to silence errors except existing 'as never' fakes
definition_of_done: All four unmet errors are gone from tsc output
